title.ur: Heating mode mein tube ka high temperature limit

meaning.en: In heat mode the inner tube temperature rose too high; compressor frequency reduced.
meaning.ur: Heating mode mein inner tube ka temperature bohat zyada ho gaya; compressor ki frequency kam ho gayi.

causes.ur: Andar (indoor) ki airflow band hai
Outdoor coil ganda hai / fan ka masla hai
Tube sensor kharab hai

solutions.en: Clean filters and outdoor coil; restart
solutions.ur: Pehle filters aur outdoor coil saaf karein; phir restart karein

solutions.en: Technician: verify tube sensor and charge
solutions.ur: Technician tube sensor aur charge verify kare

title.ur: Defrost mode (yeh kharabi nahi, aam hal hai)

meaning.en: Outdoor coil frost triggered automatic defrost; heating pauses briefly then resumes. Normal operation.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil par baarf jamne par unit khud ba khud defrost kar rahi hai — heating thodi der ke liye ruk kar dobara chalti hai. Yeh aam amal hai.

causes.ur: Sardi aur nami ki wajah se barf jama hona (yeh normal hai)

causes.en: Persistent H1 may indicate defrost sensor/heat-exchanger issue
causes.ur: H1 lagatar rahe to defrost sensor/heat-exchanger ka masla ho sakta hai

solutions.en: Wait for cycle to finish; no action if heating resumes
solutions.ur: Cycle khatam hone ka intezaar karein; heating dobara shuru ho jaye to kuch na karein

solutions.en: If never resumes: technician checks control sensor and heat exchanger
solutions.ur: Agar kabhi wapas na chale: technician control sensor aur heat exchanger check kare

notes.ur: Yeh officially status code hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.

meaning.en: Unit paused to clear static/dust buildup on electrostatic filter; also described as normal self-cleaning status.
meaning.ur: Unit electrostatic filter par jama hui khak saaf karne ke liye ruk kar apna aap safai karta hai — yeh bhi aam amal hi hai.

causes.ur: Ganda electrostatic filter (yeh hona expected hai)

solutions.en: Clean or replace electrostatic filter; restart
solutions.ur: Electrostatic filter saaf ya badlein; phir restart karein

meaning.en: Overload switch opened under run/standby; after 3 trips unit will not auto-recover until power reset.
meaning.ur: Chalne ya standby mein zyada bojh girne par hifazati switch khul gaya; 3 baar trip hone ke baad unit tab tak khud theek nahi hoga jab tak power reset na kiya jaye.

causes.ur: Outdoor ki ventilation kamzor ya condenser ganda hai
Electrical overload hai ya compressor fail ho raha hai
Refrigerant flow roka hua hai

solutions.en: Power off; clean condenser; ensure clearance; cooldown then restart
solutions.ur: Pehle power band karein, condenser saaf karein, aas paas jagah khuli rakhein, thanda hone par restart karein

solutions.en: Repeats → technician (overload switch, windings, charge)
solutions.ur: Masla dobara aaye to technician bulayein (overload switch, windings, charge check ke liye)

title.en: System overload / tube & condenser overload protection
title.ur: System overload / tube aur condenser overload ki hifazat

meaning.en: Tube temperature above protective threshold → 3-min lockout; after 6 trips manual power cycle required. Also described as high condensing pressure from blocked heat exchanger.
meaning.ur: Tube ka temperature hifazati had se zyada hone par 3 minute ke liye band rehta hai; 6 baar hone par power kat kar dobara chalana zaroori hai. Kuch sources isay heat exchanger band hone ki wajah se high condensing pressure ke tor par bhi bayan karte hain.

causes.en: Blocked or inefficient outdoor heat exchanger
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger band hai ya theek se kaam nahi kar raha
Overload ya zyada condensing pressure

causes.en: Control board or install fault (if persists after restart)
causes.ur: Control board ya installation ka masla (restart ke baad bhi rahe to)

solutions.en: Clean or service heat exchanger; restore airflow
solutions.ur: Heat exchanger saaf ya service karein; wapas airflow theek karein

solutions.en: If repeats after clean restart: technician inspects board/install
solutions.ur: Saaf karke restart ke baad phir aaye to technician board/installation check kare

meaning.en: Inverter power module entered protection due to voltage/temperature/current abnormality; compressor drive paused.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module ko voltage, temperature ya current ki ghabrat ke baad protection mode mein chala gaya aur compressor ka drive ruk gaya.

causes.ur: Supply voltage gair-mamooli hai
IPM/board kharab hai ya temperature zyada hai
Compressor ki wiring/insulation mein masla hai

solutions.en: Power off ~1 min and restart once
solutions.ur: Power taqreeban 1 minute band karein aur ek dafa restart karein

solutions.en: Returns → technician: outdoor PCB, voltage, compressor circuit (high stored energy — pro only)
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to technician bulayein: outdoor PCB, voltage, compressor circuit check hoga (stored energy zyada hoti hai, sirf professional)

title.ur: Indoor fan motor ki feedback nahi mil rahi

meaning.en: Controller commanded the indoor fan but received no speed feedback for ~30 s (or fan blocked). Auto-recovers unless frequent.
meaning.ur: Controller ne indoor fan chalane ka command diya magar fan se kareeb 30 second mein koi speed feedback nahi mili (ya fan block hai). Baar baar na ho to ye khud theek ho jata hai.

causes.ur: Fan wheel atka hua hai (barf, khadak)

causes.en: Failed indoor fan motor or hall sensor
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor ya hall sensor fail ho gaya

causes.en: Loose motor connector / faulty indoor board
causes.ur: Motor connector dhila hai / indoor board kharab hai

solutions.en: Clear obstruction; power-cycle
solutions.ur: Pehle rukawat hatayein; phir power cycle karein

solutions.en: Technician: test motor and feedback line; replace motor/board as needed
solutions.ur: Technician motor aur feedback line test kare; zaroorat par motor/board badle

title.ur: Compressor desynchronization / steps khatam ho gaye

meaning.en: Compressor lost phase sync or steps under inverter drive.
meaning.ur: Inverter drive ke andar compressor ka phase sync ya steps kho gaya.

causes.ur: Compressor mein electrical kharabi hai

causes.en: Loose terminals or wrong phase sequence
causes.ur: Terminals dhile hain ya phase sequence ghalat hai
Main/drive board kharab hai

solutions.en: Check phase sequence and tightness of terminals
solutions.ur: Phase sequence aur terminals ki tightness check karein

solutions.en: Technician: replace board or compressor after tests
solutions.ur: Technician tests ke baad board ya compressor badle

title.en: Drain full or fan-drive IPM over-temperature
title.ur: Tank bharna ya fan drive IPM zyada garam hona

meaning.en: Two documented meanings: (1) dehumidifier water-tank full protection; (2) on outdoor 2-digit display, IPM over-temperature for fan drive.
meaning.ur: Do matlab hain: (1) dehumidifier ka water tank bhar jaane ki hifazat, (2) outdoor 2-digit display par fan drive ke IPM over temperature.

causes.ur: Tank ka structure/level switch kharab hai (dehumidifier)

causes.en: Missing/dried thermal grease, loose IPM screws, bad fan drive board
causes.ur: Thermal grease gayab/sukh gayi, IPM screws dhile, fan drive board kharab

solutions.en: Empty tank; check level switch and wiring
solutions.ur: Tank khali karein; level switch aur wiring check karein

solutions.en: Technician: service IPM thermal interface / fan drive board (AC outdoor display variant)
solutions.ur: Agar AC outdoor display version hai to technician IPM thermal interface ya fan drive board service kare

title.en: Inverter fan loss of sync (heater in some manuals)
title.ur: Inverter fan ka sync kharab (kuch manuals mein heater)

meaning.en: Outdoor/inverter fan lost commutation; also (quarantined) electric-heater fault in some RU-derived texts.
meaning.ur: Outdoor/inverter fan ki commutation khatam ho gayi; kuch source texts mein isay electric heater ki kharabi bhi likha gaya hai (quarantined).

causes.ur: UVW fan cable ka contact theek nahi hai

causes.en: Stuck/rusty fan blades or failed fan
causes.ur: Fan blades atke/zang lagaye ya fan fail ho gaya
Fan drive board kharab hai

solutions.en: Inspect fan wiring and free the wheel
solutions.ur: Fan ki wiring inspect karein aur wheel ko azaad karein

solutions.en: Technician: replace fan or drive board
solutions.ur: Technician fan ya drive board badle

meaning.en: PFC stage faulted or overloaded; drive enters protection.
meaning.ur: PFC stage fault ho gaya ya overload hua; drive protection mein chala gaya.

causes.ur: PFC module ya sensor kharab hai
Supply ki quality theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the unit, then check mains supply quality before opening the outdoor board area
solutions.ur: Unit band karke isolate karein, outdoor board area kholne se pehle mains supply ki quality check karein

solutions.en: A technician inspects the PFC circuit and module for damage and replaces the PFC module or sensor if it tests faulty
solutions.ur: Technician PFC circuit aur module ko damage ke liye check kare aur kharab hone par PFC module ya sensor badle

meaning.en: Compressor rotor magnet strength / demag condition detected; unit stops to avoid damage.
meaning.ur: Rotor ke magnet ki strength ya demag condition kharab hone ki nishani mili; nuksan se bachane ke liye unit band ho gaya.

causes.ur: Compressor ki electrical condition kharab ho rahi hai
Lambe arse tak zyada temperature par chalna

solutions.en: Do not restart repeatedly; power off and arrange professional inspection to avoid further compressor damage
solutions.ur: Baar baar restart na karein; power band karein aur compressor ko aur nuqsan se bachane ke liye professional inspection karwayein

solutions.en: A technician tests the compressor windings and insulation resistance, then repairs or replaces the compressor
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki windings aur insulation resistance test kare, phir compressor repair ya replace kare
